gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.

gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to cook — we ate out.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but it happened; 'we ate out' shows the cooking served no purpose.

gaps.lead: They won't allow you to enter without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: allow somebody to do → be allowed to do: won't be allowed to enter.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be on a beach now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past (subjunctive were): I wish I were. 'was' is informal — only 'were' fits the keyword.

gaps.sentence: Travel is ___ if you go off-peak.

gaps.lead: He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.
